snippet.title: Michael Cinco: the Filipino from Samar who made Sofia Vergara's Golden Globes gown
snippet.description:
Michael Cinco is a Filipino from Samar, and Sofia Vergara wore his gown to the Golden Globes in 2013.

He got there the long way. He was the fifth of eight kids in Catbalogan, and he says his dad, a radio technician, believed fashion was only for women. His mom backed him anyway.

His sister remembers the first "gowns." When they played Miss Universe as kids, she says, he was the one who dressed her, and those gowns were just blankets.

Then work took him to Saudi Arabia, which he calls a culture shock. But being Filipino, he says, he adapted easily. Next came Dubai, where he started as an assistant designer at a big fashion house, and the first client they gave him was one of the royal families.

Not everyone cheered. He says some Filipino designers tore his work apart. So in 2003 he started his own fashion company, and he let the gowns do the talking. Some of his wedding gowns can take a thousand hours, just for the embroidery.

Ten years later, the Golden Globes. That same year, his dress went to the Met Gala.

Asked for the biggest lesson of his career, he didn't talk about gowns. He said you have to trust your instincts. And when the host told him they were proud of him, he said he's just very proud to be Filipino.

Doubted at home. Put down by some of his own. And a gown from Samar still made it to the Golden Globes. 🇵🇭

Source: GMA Public Affairs, ABS-CBN News, Tatler Asia

snippet.title: Bambu Patah! 🚚 Truk Molen Nyaris Terjun Bebas di Jembatan Bambu Kampung! #Shorts
snippet.description:
Momen menegangkan saat sebuah truk molen (concrete mixer truck) bermuatan penuh nekat melintasi jembatan bambu darurat yang sangat sempit di perkampungan warga! Baru melangkah beberapa meter, beban puluhan ton membuat konstruksi bambu retak dan salah satu roda belakang terperosok ke celah jembatan hingga tersangkut parah di atas aliran parit.

Situasi langsung mendadak genting! Supir yang terjebak di dalam kabin tidak berani memaksakan gas karena risiko truk terbalik atau jembatan patah total. Melihat kondisi tersebut, warga desa langsung berhamburan datang memberikan pertolongan darurat. Dimulai dari aksi bapak-bapak yang menjadi pemandu aba-aba dadakan, warga yang sigap membawakan balok kayu pengganjal roda, hingga koordinasi cepat mendatangkan alat berat excavator untuk menahan sasis dan menarik truk keluar dari jebakan jembatan.

Aksi gotong royong dan kekompakan warga pedesaan ini membuktikan kepedulian nyata saat musibah tak terduga terjadi di jalanan sempit. Saksikan detik-detik proses evakuasi menegangkan yang penuh drama dan celotehan spontan khas warga kampung!

Tonton video ini sampai habis untuk melihat apakah truk molen raksasa ini berhasil selamat dan menyeberang tanpa merobohkan jembatan bambu warga!

snippet.description:
このつやつやした黒い棒は「オガ炭」と呼ばれる炭です。製材所や家具工場で出るおがくずをスクリュー式の機械に入れ、高い圧力と熱をかけて押し出します。熱で木にふくまれる「リグニン」という成分がやわらかくなり、のりの代わりになるため、接着剤を加えなくても形が固まり、表面のつやもこのリグニンによるものです。中心には空気が通る穴があいています。これを窯で焼いて炭にします。密度が高く大きさもそろっているため、煙やにおいが少なく、4時間以上燃えるとされ、長い棒は必要な長さにポキッと折って使えます。

snippet.title: 리센느가 뜬 뒤 진짜 달라진 건…
snippet.description:
같은 노래, 같은 리센느.
그런데 시간이 흐른 뒤 무대가 조금 다르게 느껴집니다.🥹

러브어택이 더 많은 사랑을 받기 전에도
리센느는 충분히 예뻤고,
언제나 무대에 진심이었어요.

하늘하늘한 의상도,
한 동작 한 동작 열심히 추던 모습도
지금 다시 보니 더 애틋하네요.

그땐 아직 많은 사람이 몰랐을 뿐…

시간이 흘러 달라진 스타일링,
그리고 더 많은 사람의 관심을 받게 된 리센느.

해외가 아닌 국내 팬들의 댓글 중
특히 마음에 남았던 말이 있어요.

“원래 의상도 예쁜데?”
“의상이 한 번도 대충인 적 없었는데.”
“팬들 함성이 커지니 무대가 더 빛나더라.”

그때의 노력까지
이제 함께 빛나는 것 같아서
괜히 마음이 뭉클해집니다.ㅠㅠ

리센느야,
그때도 예뻤고 지금도 예뻐.
앞으로는 더 많은 사랑을 받길.❤️

같은 노래, 같은 리센느.
그런데 시간이 흐른 뒤 무대가 조금 다르게 느껴집니다.🥹

러브어택이 더 많은 사랑을 받기 전에도
리센느는 충분히 예뻤고,
언제나 무대에 진심이었어요.

하늘하늘한 의상도,
한 동작 한 동작 열심히 추던 모습도
지금 다시 보니 더 애틋하네요.

그땐 아직 많은 사람이 몰랐을 뿐…

시간이 흘러 달라진 스타일링,
그리고 더 많은 사람의 관심을 받게 된 리센느.

해외가 아닌 국내 팬들의 댓글 중
특히 마음에 남았던 말이 있어요.

“원래 의상도 예쁜데?”
“의상이 한 번도 대충인 적 없었는데.”
“팬들 함성이 커지니 무대가 더 빛나더라.”

그때의 노력까지
이제 함께 빛나는 것 같아서
괜히 마음이 뭉클해집니다.ㅠㅠ

리센느야,
그때도 예뻤고 지금도 예뻐.
앞으로는 더 많은 사랑을 받길.❤️

여러분은 언제 처음 리센느를 알게 되셨나요?

震源から離れた福島県浪江町、大熊町、双葉町で最大震度3を観測しました。

今回の地震は震源が非常に深い「深発地震」であり、地震波が伝わりやすい太平洋プレートに沿って揺れが伝わる「異常震域」と呼ばれる現象が起きました。そのため、震源に近い近畿や東海よりも、関東から東北の太平洋側で揺れが大きくなりました。
なお、震源が深いため、今後大きな余震が起きる可能性は低いと見られます。

snippet.title: Can Too Much Rain Kill Lettuce Plants?
snippet.description: Heavy rainfall can cause water to collect around lettuce roots when the soil has poor drainage, reducing the oxygen they need to function properly. Prolonged waterlogging can cause yellowing, wilting, and root damage, while raised beds or ridges with proper drainage help excess water flow away and keep the roots healthy.
